people.name: Beth-togarmah
people.line: Region or people group trading with Tyre, allied with Gog.

people.name: Gomer
people.line: Son of Japheth; father of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

translations.web: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many peoples with you.
translations.bsb: as well as Gomer with all its troops, and Beth-togarmah from the far north with all its troops—the many nations with you.
translations.kjv: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people
